🔥 legend | Jinja
🎯 Primary Use Case: Automating the generation and deployment of Grafana dashboards for monitoring services and infrastructure.
✨ Key Features: • Builds dashboards for services with prefilled metrics • Customizable alerts and panels • Automatic setup of basic alerts with priority and service mapping • Uniform dashboard layout • Supports a wide range of components including Airflow, AWS services, Kubernetes, databases, and web servers
📖 Summary: Legend is a tool that automates the creation and publishing of Grafana dashboards for various services and infrastructure components. It pre-fills dashboards with relevant metrics and alerts, reducing manual configuration effort.
